evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact says Cloud Firewall and VPC programming failed from 15:20 Pacific on 16 May 2024. End: Mini Incident Report gives incident end of 18:10 Pacific, matching the majority of impact. Regions: Report says Global; VPC controllers shut down in all zones; 40 regions and Global listed.
notes: Published date is the full Incident Report entry (22 May 2024 09:44 PDT). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). The Mini Incident Report gives incident start 15:22 PDT; the earliest per-product impact stated is 15:20 PDT (Cloud Firewall, VPC); early status updates said 14:44 PDT. End 18:10 PDT is the stated incident end and the end of the 2 hours 48 minutes of majority impact; the report also says the dataplane backlog cleared by 18:40 PDT, and long tails ran later (Redis 20:05, Cloud SQL 22:30, Apigee Edge partial deployments 17 May 01:00 PDT). europe-north2 is named only in the AlloyDB section and is absent from the location list; it is coded as stated. Zones us-east1-c and us-east4-c are named for data plane loss. services_n counts distinct products named as impaired across the header, Mini Incident Report and detailed impact, merging Managed Airflow with Cloud Composer and Agent Platform Workbench with Vertex AI Workbench, counting Apigee and Apigee Edge Public Cloud separately, and leaving out the umbrella categories Cloud Developer Tools, Cloud Machine Learning, Cloud Memorystore, Google Cloud Networking and Hybrid Connectivity.

evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact says the partial outage began 18:45 Pacific on 8 May 2024. End: Same section and Mini Incident Report end it at 21:40 Pacific. Regions: Summary places the outage in zone australia-southeast1-a; HA Cloud SQL failed over to other zones.
notes: Published date is the full Incident Report entry (21 May 2024 15:51 PDT). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7); 8 May 18:45 PDT is 9 May 01:45 UTC. The page header gives 19:00 to 22:28 PDT; the power event itself began 18:44 PDT. The report says all services recovered by 21:55 PDT, with a few Persistent Disk devices and Cloud SQL instances recovering later. Coded zonal: one zone named and other zones served failover; GKE and Dialogflow sections speak of the region. services_n counts Persistent Disk, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Compute Engine, Filestore, VPC, Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, Bigtable, Apigee, Memorystore for Redis, Dialogflow and GKE; header categories Google Cloud Networking and Operations not counted.
